description: Resolve Auth Credentials on the channels node and inject secrets through a final Req step without exposing plaintext.

comments.text: Added Channels.HttpClient.CredentialInjector. It resolves Auth Credentials only on the channels node, validates http:<provider_id> dynamic provider refs, enforces provider enabled/host-pattern rules, injects bearer/header/query credentials into final Req options, and keeps plaintext out of response/error values. Focused credential/channel tests pass.

title: [zaq-w3s] Req secret injection
